note: Every value names its standard. 'status' says how it was checked in THIS session: verified_2_sources = two independent web tables agree; verified_1_source = one table; derived_rule = computed by a rule of the standard (stated); recalled_unverified = from engineering memory, no table could be opened (paywalled standard) -> treat as ASSUMED until checked; not_available = no value (never invented).

standards.ASME B36.10M: Welded and seamless wrought steel pipe
standards.EN 558: Industrial valves - face-to-face and centre-to-face dimensions (paywalled; values below are recalled)
standards.ISO 15874: PP-R plastic piping systems for hot and cold water
standards.EN 1329: PVC-U soil and waste inside buildings
standards.EN 1519: PE soil and waste inside buildings
standards.EN 1057: Copper tubes for water and gas

dn_alias.note: BOQ lists 75 (NPS 3 = DN80); nominal alias, assumed

flange_class150.standard: ASME B16.5 Class 150 (weld neck, raised face)
flange_class150.note: RF height 1.6 mm is included in the thickness; slip-on thickness differs and is not tabulated here

reducer_concentric.note: H depends on the LARGE end only (pairs listed on the source page)

valve_face_to_face.note: EN 558 is paywalled and no table could be opened; values are the commonly quoted lengths of the series and must be treated as ASSUMED until checked

ppr_pn20.rule: wall e = d/6 rounded to 0.1 (SDR 6); ID = d - 2e

upvc_soil_waste_en1329.note: EN 1329 wall thickness could not be confirmed (an EN 1453 table shows 3.2 mm but that is another standard); no wall is invented

hdpe_soil_waste_en1519.note: no accessible table; kitchen grease drains drawn with the uPVC OD series, assumed

copper_en1057.note: 15 and 22 from a typical-dimensions list; 28-54 derived from a retailer's ID list (OD-ID)/2; verify

upvc_pressure_iso1452.note: wall thickness per PN not confirmed; fill/overflow/riser uPVC pressure lines are drawn with their label OD, assumed

grooved_coupling.note: no standard; generic envelope used for kits: body OD = pipe OD + 25 mm, length = 60 mm (assumed, not from any catalogue)

insulation.source: BOQ 12.9.1 + MECH1 ص9–10 (chilled water: >= 25 mm indoors, >= 50 mm outdoors, aluminium cladding 20G) and MECH2 ص24 ملاحظة 7 (glass wool 0.032 W/mK: 25 mm in conditioned space, 50 mm exposed)
assumed: exposed = levels R and T only (plant rooms/basement/OTS shafts are not located in the data)
cold water is insulated only when exposed (WS notes 2-3); the PN of cold-water PPR is not stated (PN20 assumed)
storm/condensate insulation thickness is not stated -> none drawn

steel_water_service.standard: MSS SP-58 family (maximum horizontal spacing, standard steel pipe, water service) as tabulated by Engineering ToolBox
steel_water_service.attribution: the source page does not name the standard (SP-58 vs SP-69 style); treated as the recommended-spacing table

assumed.32: 1-1/4 in is not in the table: taken equal to 1 in
assumed.125: NPS 5 is not in the table: midpoint of 4 in and 6 in

steel_water_service.rod_status: unverified: the source labels two rod columns without naming the pipe material; column 1 used

fire_nfpa13.standard: NFPA 13 Table 17.4.2.1(a) (steel pipe except threaded lightwall)
fire_nfpa13.note: 12 ft (3.66 m) up to 1-1/4 in, 15 ft (4.57 m) from 1-1/2 in; reproduced by a permit form, not the code text
fire_nfpa13.rod_status: 3/8 in up to 4 in verified (NFPA 13 Table 17.2.1.1 via report); 5 in and above assumed

upvc_drain_dr106.standard: drawing MECH2 ص9 (DR-106) support-spacing table, uPVC
upvc_drain_dr106.nearest_size_rule: sizes not listed use the nearest listed size (a tie goes to the smaller spacing)

sleeve.standard: MECH1 ص9–10 / MECH2 ص16 / S-N4: Sch 40 steel sleeve with 2-hour firestop at every slab or fire-wall penetration
sleeve.rule: sleeve inside diameter >= pipe jacket OD + 10 mm, smallest ASME B36.10M Sch 40 size; length = slab zone (level top to next finished floor)
sleeve.wall_penetrations: not generated: which walls are fire-rated is not located in the data
